description: This file defines the RepositoriesViewModel class, which manages repository data, user interactions, and UI state for the repositories screen in an Android app. It handles repository list updates, reordering, enabling/disabling repositories, and onboarding flow control.

classes.name: RepositoriesViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing repository data, user interactions, and onboarding for the repositories UI in an Android app.

methods.name: onRepositoriesChanged
methods.description: Updates repository list and sorting map when repositories change.

methods.name: onRepositoryEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a repository and triggers update checks.

methods.name: onRepositoriesMoved
methods.description: Updates the sorting order of repositories when moved.

methods.name: onRepositoriesFinishedMoving
methods.description: Finalizes repository reordering after move operation.
